class.name: IfcSpatialStructureElement
class.brief_description: A spatial structure element ( IfcSpatialStructureElement ) is the generalization of all spatial elements that might be used to define a spatial structure. That spatial structure is often used to provide a project structure to organize a building project. members.member: Denotes, whether the predefined spatial structure element represents itself, or an aggregate (complex) or a part (part). The interpretation is given separately for each subtype of spatial structure element. If no CompositionType is asserted, the dafault value 'ELEMENT' applies. IFC2x4 CHANGE Attribute made optional.
